terra.problem: The line suggests that the exile followed Jerusalem’s final fall. Jehoiachin and others were taken to Babylon earlier, after his surrender (2 Kings 24:10–17).
“Jehoiachin Taken Captive” and “Zedekiah Taken to Babylon” describe events in Jerusalem and Riblah and journeys to Babylon, not events shown happening in the city of Babylon.
“A Letter to the Exiles” describes a letter sent from Jerusalem to exiles in Babylon; the passage does not show the letter being delivered or read in the city.
“Daniel Saves the Wise Men” overstates what Daniel 2:12–24 says. In this passage, Daniel asks Arioch not to execute them; it does not say they were saved.
“The Golden Statue” takes place in the province of Babylon, not necessarily in the city itself.
